about: The corresponding source of the one copyleft binary the PDF viewer ships that is not TeX Live's or ours: pdf.js's Liberation Sans fonts (dist/viewer/pdfjs/standard_fonts/LiberationSans-*.ttf, GPL-2.0 with Red Hat's font-embedding exception). A release that holds them attaches this archive (scripts/release-sources.mjs, group 'viewer'), so the offer does not depend on another project's server (GPL-2 section 3a). The fonts' name table says Version 1.07.4; the source is Liberation 1.x's repository at its last commit that still says 1.07.4 (its fonts' .sfd files, ChangeLog and licence texts; later commits are README changes after the 1.07.4 release, the 1.07.5 commit follows). The TrueType files in pdf.js are built from these .sfd files by FontForge; a byte-for-byte rebuild has not been tried.
